ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: ESSENTIAL MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Solve for x: x + 4 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 14
   C. 11
   D. 10

2. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 48
   C. 24
   D. 156

3. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 82
   C. 18
   D. 81

4. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 12
   C. 1
   D. 7

5. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 81
   C. 36
   D. 18

6. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 7
   C. 13
   D. 15

7. What is 8 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 32
   C. 12
   D. 4

8. What is 8 × 6? (1 mark)
   A. 48
   B. 14
   C. 49
   D. 2

9. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

10. Which list shows all factors of 6? (1 mark)
   A. 3, 6, 9
   B. 1, 2, 3, 6
   C. 2, 4, 6
   D. 1, 6

11. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 24
   B. 36
   C. 12
   D. 42

12. 1 hectare equals how many square metres? (1 mark)
   A. 1000 m²
   B. 100 000 m²
   C. 10 000 m²
   D. 100 m²

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

Final Answer: x = 10
